defects.code:
procedure @@proc@@(p_kind in number, p_msg out varchar2) is
begin
  case p_kind
    when 3 then
      p_msg := 'it''s @@str@@'; -- @expect
    when 4 then
      p_msg := 'it''s @@str@@'; -- @expect
    when 5 then
      p_msg := 'it''s @@str@@' || p_kind; -- @expect
    else
      p_msg := null;
  end case;
end @@proc@@;
